title_zh: 特朗普称CFTC正推动Hyperliquid进入美国
title_en: Trump Says CFTC Working to Bring Hyperliquid to US
summary_zh: 在特朗普与加密高管的白宫会议上，总统表示CFTC主席Michael Selig正在努力以完全合规的方式将Hyperliquid带入美国。消息公布后，HYPE上涨23%，LIT上涨20%，比特币升至72,000美元，以太坊突破2,300美元。 这一表态标志着离岸永续合约交易平台可能获得进入美国市场的监管路径，可能重塑美国用户参与加密杠杆交易的方式。这也表明在《清晰法案》仍停滞于国会之际，SEC和CFTC正在自行推进规则制定。 Hyperliquid是一个离岸平台，用户通过连接钱包交易永续合约（无到期日的合约），这种结构绕开了美国衍生品规则所假设存在的中介机构。CFTC此前已批准Coinbase Derivatives和Kalshi提供类似产品，其创新顾问委员会将于周四召开会议。
summary_en: At a White House meeting with crypto executives, President Trump said CFTC Chair Michael Selig is working to bring Hyperliquid into the United States in a fully compliant manner. HYPE jumped 23% and LIT rose 20% following the announcement, while Bitcoin climbed to $72k and Ether passed $2,300. The statement signals a potential regulatory pathway for offshore perpetual futures venues to operate in the US, which could reshape how Americans access leveraged crypto trading. It also shows the SEC and CFTC advancing their own rulemaking while the Clarity Act remains stalled in Congress. Hyperliquid is an offshore venue where traders use perpetual futures—contracts with no expiration date—by connecting a wallet, a structure that bypasses the intermediaries US derivatives rules assume exist. The CFTC has been building toward this by clearing Coinbase Derivatives and Kalshi for similar products, and its Innovation Advisory Committee meets Thursday.

title_zh: 恶意 Rust crate arrayref 构建时执行恶意负载
title_en: Malicious Rust crate arrayref runs build-time payload
summary_zh: 流行的 Rust crate arrayref 的恶意版本 0.3.10 首次添加了对拼写错误仿冒 crate proc-macro1 的依赖，其 build 脚本会在编译时下载并执行远程二进制文件。Rust 官方团队和 RustSec 公告数据库已于 2026 年 8 月 20 日发出官方警告，该恶意版本也已从 crates.io 移除。 由于 arrayref 使用广泛，且恶意代码在构建过程中执行，任何编译了该恶意版本的开发者或 CI/CD 系统都可能被感染，而无需运行项目自身代码。这突显了针对 Rust/crates.io 生态系统的供应链攻击的系统性风险。 恶意版本的 arrayref 0.3.10 由合法维护者账号 'droundy' 于 2026-08-20 发布，其依赖的 proc-macro1 1.0.107 在几分钟前由账号 'dtolney' 发布。proc-macro1 的 build.rs 会下载并执行远程载荷；安全研究人员称这是一个多阶段信息窃取程序，并具备第二阶段后门能力。
summary_en: A malicious release of the popular Rust crate arrayref (version 0.3.10) added a first-ever dependency on a typosquatted crate, proc-macro1, whose build script downloads and executes a remote binary at compile time. The Rust team and RustSec advisory database issued official warnings on August 20, 2026, and the malicious version was removed from crates.io. Because arrayref is widely used and the malware executes during the build process, any developer or CI/CD system that builds the compromised version may be infected without running the project's own code. This highlights the systemic risk of supply-chain attacks on the Rust/crates.io ecosystem. The malicious arrayref 0.3.10 was published on 2026-08-20 by the legitimate maintainer account 'droundy', and it depends on proc-macro1 1.0.107, which was published minutes earlier by account 'dtolney'. The build.rs of proc-macro1 downloads and executes a remote payload; security researchers describe it as a multi-stage info-stealer with stage-2 backdoor capabilities.

title_zh: GitHub 8月17日宕机事件复盘：容量故障与扩展挑战
title_en: GitHub's August 17 Outage Postmortem: Capacity Failures and Scaling Challenges
summary_zh: GitHub 发布了 8 月 17 日宕机事件的复盘报告，将其归因于容量故障和扩展问题，事件影响了包括 GitHub Actions 在内的服务。据报道，月度提交量从 4 月的 14 亿次翻倍增长至 29 亿次。 这次宕机影响了数百万依赖 GitHub 进行代码托管和 CI/CD 的开发者及企业用户。它凸显了超高速增长带来的运营压力，并引发了对资源分配、免费套餐影响以及广泛使用的开发者平台基础设施韧性的思考。 复盘报告描述了两次与容量相关的事件，并承认在需求超出容量之前未能扩展关键组件。社区评论者指出，自 4 月以来月度提交量从 14 亿增长到 29 亿，恰好与全行业围绕 AI 工具的“生产力焦虑”相吻合。
summary_en: GitHub published a postmortem for the August 17 outage, attributing it to capacity failures and scaling issues that disrupted services including GitHub Actions. Monthly commits reportedly doubled from 1.4 billion in April to 2.9 billion. The outage affected millions of developers and enterprise users who rely on GitHub for code hosting and CI/CD. It highlights the operational pressures of hyper-growth and raises questions about resource allocation, free-tier impacts, and infrastructure resilience in widely used developer platforms. The postmortem describes two capacity-related incidents and acknowledges that critical components were not scaled before demand exceeded capacity. Community commenters noted that the growth in commits, from 1.4 billion to 2.9 billion monthly since April, coincided with industry-wide 'productivity panic' around AI tooling.

title_zh: 特朗普椭圆形办公室会议力挺《CLARITY法案》
title_en: Trump 'bullish' on Clarity Act in Oval Office meeting with crypto CEOs
summary_zh: 在一次私人椭圆形办公室会议上，特朗普总统对《CLARITY法案》的通过表现出“看涨”态度，并向加密货币和金融业CEO征求反馈。此次会议显示白宫在拟议立法上展开了早期接触。 这是一个高价值的监管信号，因为总统的支持可能会影响《CLARITY法案》的立法进程，该法案旨在为数字资产建立统一的联邦框架。明确的规则可能实质性改善美国加密企业的市场准入和行业结构。 《CLARITY法案》已在众议院通过，目前正在参议院审议。此次会议是私下且早期的接触，因此未披露具体承诺或时间表。
summary_en: During a private Oval Office meeting, President Trump appeared 'bullish' on passing the Clarity Act and solicited feedback from crypto and finance CEOs. The meeting signals early-stage White House engagement on the proposed legislation. This is a high-value regulatory signal because presidential support can shape the legislative path of the Clarity Act, which aims to provide a unified federal framework for digital assets. Clear rules could materially improve market access and industry structure for US crypto businesses. The Clarity Act has already passed the House and is undergoing review in the Senate. The meeting was private and early-stage, so specific commitments or timelines were not disclosed.

title_zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索海外设立全能银行
title_en: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming full bank outside US
summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward正在探索在海外成为一家全能银行，业务范围将扩展至银行、贷款和资产管理，未来还可能涉及抵押贷款。 此举标志着加密货币行业进一步机构化，主要参与者正进军传统金融服务领域。这也可能为其他寻求在海外获得银行牌照的加密公司开创先例，模糊加密货币与传统银行之间的界限。 目前该探索仍处于战略阶段，尚未获得监管最终批准，也不会产生直接影响。该银行将在美国以外运营，但具体司法管辖区尚未披露。
summary_en: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is exploring becoming a full bank outside the US, expanding into banking, lending, and asset management, with mortgages a future possibility. This move signals further institutionalization of the crypto industry as major players push into traditional financial services. It could also set a precedent for other crypto firms seeking banking licenses abroad, blurring the line between crypto and conventional banking. The exploration is at a strategic stage, with no regulatory finality or immediate market impact. The bank would operate outside the US, though specific jurisdictions have not been disclosed.

title_zh: Binance推出Agent OS，让AI代理在用户控制下进行加密货币交易
title_en: Binance launches Agent OS, opening crypto trading to AI agents with user-set controls
summary_zh: Binance推出了Agent OS开发者平台，允许AI代理访问市场数据、监控账户并在交易所执行加密货币交易。该平台支持ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex和Cursor等AI工具，并带有用户配置的权限和限额。 这标志着头部交易所向自主AI驱动交易迈出的重要一步，可能重塑加密货币交易的执行和管理方式。它还加速了AI代理参与链上和金融基础设施的更大趋势，影响交易者、开发者以及AI与加密生态。 用户可以将AI代理分配到专用子账户以隔离资金和活动，随时设置权限或撤销访问。Binance能监控通过Agent OS进行的交易，但看不到代理的外部数据源或决策过程，且该服务不面向欧洲经济区（EEA）用户。
summary_en: Binance has launched Agent OS, a developer platform that lets AI agents access market data, monitor accounts, and execute crypto trades on the exchange. The platform supports AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, with user-configured permissions and limits. This marks a major step by a leading exchange toward autonomous AI-driven trading, potentially reshaping how crypto trades are executed and managed. It also accelerates the broader trend of AI agents participating in onchain and financial infrastructure, affecting traders, developers, and the AI-crypto ecosystem. Users can assign agents to dedicated subaccounts to isolate funds and activity, set permissions, and revoke access at any time. Binance can monitor trades placed through Agent OS but cannot see an agent's external data sources or decision-making, and the service is not available to users in the EEA.

title_zh: LayerZero年内流失十二家合作伙伴，ZRO代币下跌31%
title_en: LayerZero loses a dozen partners as ZRO drops 31% in 2025
summary_zh: LayerZero今年已失去十二家合作伙伴，包括Nethermind、Kelp DAO、Kraken和BitGo，其ZRO代币下跌了三分之一。最新离开的Nethermind于本周三终止了其验证者角色，并迁移至竞争对手。 这一大规模退出表明，在Lazarus Group事件后，市场对LayerZero安全模型的信任度下降，数十亿美元桥接资产正在撤出。作为领先的互操作性平台，失去主要企业和机构用户会削弱网络效应，并可能重塑跨链桥格局。 截至7月初，已有超过70亿美元资产迁出LayerZero，BitGo的退出使累计总额接近150亿美元。7月，LayerZero宣布将停止对低活跃度链的支持，并为仍使用v1库的团队设定了8月3日的截止期限。
summary_en: LayerZero has lost a dozen partnerships this year, including Nethermind, Kelp DAO, Kraken, and BitGo, as its ZRO token fell by a third. The latest departure, Nethermind, terminated its role as a verifier on Wednesday and migrated to a competitor. This exodus signals declining trust in LayerZero's security model after the Lazarus Group incident, with billions in bridged assets moving off the protocol. As a leading interoperability platform, losing major enterprise and institutional users erodes network effects and could reshape the cross-chain bridge landscape. By early July, more than $7 billion in assets had already migrated off LayerZero, and BitGo's exit pushed the cumulative total toward $15 billion. In July, LayerZero announced it was winding down support for low-activity chains and set an August 3 deadline for teams still using v1 libraries.

title_zh: Optimism治理将5.469亿OP由空投转拨至生态增长基金
title_en: Optimism moves 546.9M OP from airdrops to ecosystem growth fund
summary_zh: Optimism治理已批准一项提案，将此前预留给用户空投的5.469亿枚OP代币重新划入新的战略生态基金。该基金将用于支持合作伙伴关系、激励计划以及包括OP Enterprise在内的机构采用工作。 这一决定实质性地改变了OP的代币分配，标志着从空投驱动获取用户转向机构与生态增长的战略转变。它重塑了用户的预期，并可能影响OP Superchain生态中的激励结构。 Optimism表示，在先前五轮共分发2.691亿枚OP之后，目前没有进一步空投的计划。按当前价格计算，重新分配的5.469亿枚OP价值约5000万美元，接近OP约2.11亿美元市值的四分之一。
summary_en: Optimism's governance has approved a proposal to repurpose 546.9 million OP tokens previously reserved for user airdrops into a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund. The fund will back partnerships, incentives, and institutional adoption including OP Enterprise. This decision materially changes OP's token distribution and signals a shift from airdrop-driven user acquisition toward institutional and enterprise growth. It reshapes user expectations and may influence incentives across the OP Superchain ecosystem. Optimism said no additional airdrops are planned after distributing 269.1 million OP across five previous rounds. At current prices, the reallocated 546.9 million OP is worth about $50 million, close to a quarter of OP's roughly $211 million market cap.

title_zh: GnosisDAO 批准 Gnosis Chain 转型为以太坊经济区 Rollup
title_en: GnosisDAO Approves Gnosis Chain Transition to Ethereum Economic Zone Rollup
summary_zh: GnosisDAO 批准了 GIP-153，以 123,158 GNO 赞成票通过，将 Gnosis Chain 从独立的 Layer-1 转型为直接结算到以太坊的 ZK 证明以太坊经济区（EEZ）Rollup。暂定启动窗口为 2026 年底或 2027 年初，具体取决于 EEZ 技术是否就绪。 这一决定使 Gnosis Chain 成为首个生产级 EEZ 实例，是统一以太坊碎片化 L2 生态的重要一步，旨在让不同 Rollup 之间的智能合约无需依赖桥接即可同步交互。同时，Gnosis Chain 的安全与结算模式将从自有验证者集转变为依赖以太坊验证者。 提案 GIP-153 以 123,158 GNO 支持、115 反对和 151 弃权的结果通过，共 54 名投票者，总投票数 123,425 GNO，超过了 75,000 的法定人数。Gnosis Chain 将退役其验证者集，保留 xDAI 作为 Gas 代币，并作为首个部署的 EEZ 实例推出，同时保留现有应用和余额。
summary_en: GnosisDAO approved GIP-153, passing with 123,158 GNO in favor, to transition Gnosis Chain from a standalone layer-1 into a ZK-proven Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) rollup that settles directly on Ethereum. The tentative launch window is late 2026 or early 2027, pending readiness of EEZ technology. This decision makes Gnosis Chain the first production EEZ instance, a significant step toward unifying Ethereum's fragmented L2 ecosystem by enabling synchronous composability across rollups without relying on bridges. It also changes Gnosis Chain's security and settlement model, shifting from its own validator set to Ethereum's validators. The proposal GIP-153 passed with 123,158 GNO in support, 115 against, and 151 abstentions across 54 voters, with turnout of 123,425 GNO exceeding the 75,000 quorum. Gnosis Chain will retire its validator set, retain xDAI as its gas token, and launch as the first deployed EEZ instance while keeping existing applications and balances.

title_zh: Arbitrum 激活 Elara 升级，为专属链引入可选合规过滤器
title_en: Arbitrum Activates Elara Upgrade With Optional Compliance Filters
summary_zh: Arbitrum 平台已激活 ArbOS 61 Elara 升级，为专属 Arbitrum 链带来可选的合规过滤、可自定义优先费以及替代数据 API，同时为 Arbitrum One 提供了更高效的基准费用机制。合规筛查由链所有者而非 ArbitrumDAO 控制，而在 Arbitrum One 上，优先费仍处于禁用状态，等待进一步的治理投票。 此次升级在 L2/L3 链上引入了协议级合规工具，同时不将筛查强加于 Arbitrum One，从而保留了 DAO 的控制权和用户中立性。这可能使 Arbitrum 技术栈对需要专属链上交易过滤的机构和受监管实体更具吸引力。 ArbOS 61 Elara 还将 Stylus 合约大小上限提高了四倍，扩大了 Arbitrum 链上的智能合约容量。合规过滤在两层运作——定序器（Sequencer）和状态转换函数（STF）——确保无论交易如何进入系统，受限活动都会被阻止，并且该功能在 Arbitrum One 和 Nova 上默认保持关闭。
summary_en: The Arbitrum platform activated the ArbOS 61 Elara upgrade, bringing optional compliance filtering, customizable priority fees, and an alternative data API to dedicated Arbitrum chains, while delivering a more efficient base fee mechanism on Arbitrum One. Chain owners—not the ArbitrumDAO—control compliance screening on dedicated networks, and priority fees remain disabled on Arbitrum One pending a further governance vote. This upgrade introduces protocol-level compliance tooling for Layer 2/3 chains without imposing screening on Arbitrum One, preserving DAO control and user neutrality. It could make the Arbitrum stack more attractive to institutions and regulated entities that need on-chain transaction filtering for dedicated chains. ArbOS 61 Elara also quadruples Stylus contract size limits, expanding smart-contract capacity on Arbitrum chains. Compliance filtering operates across two layers—the Sequencer and the State Transition Function (STF)—ensuring restricted activity is blocked regardless of how a transaction enters the system, and it remains off by default on Arbitrum One and Nova.

title_zh: 币安将于2026年9月下架ICX、SCRT和STORJ
title_en: Binance to Delist ICX, SCRT, and STORJ in September 2026
summary_zh: 币安宣布将于2026年9月3日03:00（UTC）下架ICON（ICX）、Secret（SCRT）和Storj（STORJ）的所有现货交易对，并停止相关交易。币安表示这是基于最新审查结果的决定。 币安是全球最大的加密货币交易所，下架意味着这些代币失去一个主要的流动性和交易渠道。这可能会加大抛售压力，使持有者更难交易或退出头寸，也可能反映出合规或项目健康方面的隐忧。 下架适用于这三种代币的所有现货交易对，生效时间为2026年9月3日。这三者近期承压：ICX价格约0.016–0.017美元，SCRT约0.18欧元，STORJ约0.04美元，交易量相对有限。
summary_en: Binance announced it will delist and cease trading for all spot trading pairs of ICON (ICX), Secret (SCRT), and Storj (STORJ) on September 3, 2026 at 03:00 UTC. The exchange cited its latest reviews for the decision. Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, so delisting removes a major source of liquidity and trading access for these tokens. This could heighten selling pressure and make it harder for holders to trade or exit positions, and it may also signal compliance or project-health concerns. The delisting applies to all spot trading pairs for the three tokens and takes effect on 2026-09-03. Each token has been under pressure: ICX is trading around $0.016–0.017, SCRT around €0.18, and STORJ around $0.04 with relatively thin volumes.

title_zh: Tether借NYSE壳公司买入并质押竞品USDS
title_en: Tether Uses NYSE Shell Company to Buy and Stake Rival USDS
summary_zh: Tether于3月向濒临破产的生物制药公司NovaBay投资1.34亿美元，并通过反向合并将其改造为在纽交所上市、更名为Stablecoin Development Corporat的实体。该实体已被用于购买并质押大量USDS——即来自Sky Protocol（原MakerDAO）的去中心化稳定币。 这是值得关注的市场结构变化，因为全球最大的中心化稳定币发行方正在利用上市壳公司来积累竞争对手的去中心化稳定币。此举可能重塑稳定币竞争格局，引发治理与透明度方面的疑问，并让USDS获得公开市场的敞口。 Stablecoin Development Corporat的股价已从约2.00美元跌至1.00美元，且多次出现异常买盘将其推回1.00美元上方，显然是为了避免触发纽交所“连续30日低于1美元”的退市规则。该公司表示已持有USDS“超过9%的份额”，其CEO Michael Kazley称对SKY Protocol“极度看多”。
summary_en: Tether invested $134 million in the failing biopharmaceutical firm NovaBay in March and reverse-merged it into a NYSE-listed entity renamed Stablecoin Development Corporat. The vehicle has been used to purchase and stake a large amount of USDS, the decentralized stablecoin from the Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO). This is a notable market-structure shift because the world's largest centralized stablecoin issuer is using a public shell company to accumulate a rival decentralized stablecoin. It could reshape stablecoin competition, raise governance and transparency questions, and give USDS public-market exposure. Stablecoin Development Corporat's share price has collapsed from roughly $2.00 to $1.00, and unusual buy support has repeatedly pushed it back above $1.00, apparently to avoid NYSE delisting under the 30-day sub-$1 rule. The company says it has taken a 'greater than a 9% stake' in USDS, and its CEO, Michael Kazley, describes the position as 'wildly bullish' on the SKY Protocol.

title_zh: 马斯克旗下X探索以稳定币支付内容创作者
title_en: Musk's X Explores Stablecoin Payments for Content Creators
summary_zh: 据CoinDesk 2026年8月20日报道，埃隆·马斯克旗下的X平台正在探索使用稳定币向网红和内容提供者付款。该计划仍处于探索阶段，尚未确认具体使用哪种稳定币或推出时间表。 如果实现，这可能在世界上最大的社交平台之一上为稳定币提供一个极具可见度的现实支付应用场景。这也表明，主流互联网公司正越来越多地将基于加密的支付视为创作者变现的可行基础设施。 报道强调，这一探索仍处于初步阶段，X尚未公开宣布与任何稳定币发行方合作。此举将建立在马斯克长期以来对将支付功能整合进X的兴趣之上，X已在美国多个州获得货币转账牌照。
summary_en: According to a CoinDesk report dated August 20, 2026, Elon Musk's X platform is exploring the use of stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers. The effort is still in an exploratory phase and no specific stablecoin or rollout timeline has been confirmed. If realized, this could give stablecoins a massively visible real-world payments use case on one of the world's largest social platforms. It also signals that mainstream internet companies are increasingly treating crypto-based payments as a viable infrastructure for creator monetization. The report emphasizes that the exploration is preliminary and that X has not publicly announced any partnership with a stablecoin issuer. The move would build on Musk's long-standing interest in integrating payments into X, which has already obtained money-transmitter licenses in several U.S. states.

title_zh: 为何我本应爱上生物学：一篇关于教育的反思
title_en: An Essay on Why Biology Should Be Taught Through Discovery
summary_zh: 詹姆斯·索默斯（James Somers）在 2020 年发表于 jsomers.net 的随笔《我本应爱上生物学》中提出，生物学因死记硬背而丧失了魅力，教学应当转向意义与探索。该文在 Hacker News 上获得 311 个赞与 118 条评论，引发了关于教学法的深入讨论。 这篇文章能引起科技界共鸣，因为它触及了内在动力与好奇心如何驱动深度学习——这正是工程师文化所看重的价值。它也回应了 STEM 教育的长期争论：意义建构是真正理解的关键，而不仅仅是为了应付考试。 Hacker News 讨论串获得了 311 个赞和 118 条评论，评论者围绕“意义先于技巧”这一原则展开讨论，并将其与西摩·帕尔特（Seymour Papert）和让·皮亚杰（Jean Piaget）的思想联系起来。一位生命科学研究者则提出不同意见，称这是“对生命科学非常浪漫的看法”，并强调科研工作并不光鲜的现实。
summary_en: In the 2020 essay 'I Should Have Loved Biology,' published on jsomers.net, James Somers argues that biology was made unlovable by rote memorization and should instead be taught through meaning and discovery. The piece earned 311 points and 118 comments on Hacker News, sparking substantive discussion about pedagogy. The essay resonates with a technology audience because it speaks to how intrinsic motivation and curiosity drive deep learning, values at the core of engineering culture. It also contributes to ongoing debates about STEM education by arguing that meaning-making is essential for genuine understanding, not just test performance. The Hacker News thread reached 311 points and 118 comments, with commenters weighing in on the 'meaning before mechanics' principle, connecting the argument to Seymour Papert and Jean Piaget. One life-science researcher offered a counterpoint, describing the essay as 'a very romantic view of life sciences' and emphasizing the unglamorous reality of research work.

title_zh: 华盛顿全力拥抱加密：特朗普、SEC、CFTC齐推新规
title_en: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump, SEC, CFTC Advance New Rules
summary_zh: 本周，SEC首次推出针对加密资产的规则提案“Regulation Crypto Assets”，允许特定项目在四年内募资不超过500万美元或每年不超过7500万美元而无需完全注册。特朗普总统在白宫会见加密行业高管，敦促国会通过“公平版本”的Clarity Act；CFTC主席Mike Selig则启动创新咨询委员会，并警告若法案受阻，CFTC将利用现有权力自行建立加密监管框架。 这标志着美国加密政策从“以执法为主导”转向SEC和CFTC的正式规则制定，并获得白宫支持。若这些提案落地，将实质性改变数字资产在美国的发行与交易方式，影响发行方、交易所和投资者。 SEC提案包含一个有条件的“安全港”条款：当发行方的关键管理努力结束后，相关加密资产可获豁免；同时该提案将优先于部分州的证券注册要求。该提案在预定投票被突然取消几天后正式发布；CFTC主席Selig已指示工作人员研究加密资产规则。
summary_en: This week, the SEC proposed its first crypto-specific rulemaking, Regulation Crypto Assets, allowing certain offerings of up to $5 million over four years or $75 million annually without full registration. President Trump hosted crypto executives at the White House and pressed Congress to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, while CFTC Chairman Mike Selig launched the Innovation Advisory Committee and warned that the CFTC would use existing authorities to build its own crypto regime if the Act stalls. This marks a coordinated shift in U.S. crypto policy from enforcement toward formal rulemaking across both the SEC and CFTC, with White House backing. If enacted, these proposals could materially reshape how digital assets are issued and traded in the U.S., affecting issuers, exchanges, and investors. The SEC proposal includes a conditional safe harbor for crypto assets once an issuer's essential managerial efforts have ended, and it would preempt certain state securities registration requirements. The proposal was formally issued days after the scheduled vote was abruptly cancelled, and CFTC Chairman Selig has already directed staff to explore crypto-asset rules.

title_zh: Coldcard发布固件更新修复致1.3亿美元比特币被盗的种子熵漏洞
title_en: Coldcard Firmware Update Mitigates $130M Bitcoin Seed-Entropy Exploit
summary_zh: Coinkite公司在为期三周的安全审查后，为Coldcard Mk4/Mk5发布了5.6.1固件、为Coldcard Q发布了1.5.1Q固件，修复了种子生成过程中的熵缺陷。现在用户生成新种子时必须至少加入65次按键、50次掷骰子或128次抛硬币的随机输入，受影响用户被要求迁移到全新的种子。 这一漏洞直接违背了硬件钱包的核心承诺——即使设备离线，私钥也是安全的——因为攻击者可以猜出因随机性不足而生成的密钥。该事件凸显出硬件钱包的安全性完全取决于其随机数生成强度，可能促使厂商和用户要求可验证的熵来源。 据Coinkite称，该漏洞使部分设备的有效熵从128比特降至约40比特，且可追溯到2021年。此次更新还以SHA-256 Hash_DRBG替换了Yasmarang备用伪随机数生成器，增加了硬件随机数生成器故障检查，在签名前立即验证PSBT，并加强了USB和Delta Mode的处理。
summary_en: Coinkite released firmware 5.6.1 for Coldcard Mk4/Mk5 and 1.5.1Q for Coldcard Q after a three-week security review, fixing a seed-generation entropy flaw. Users now must add at least 65 key presses, 50 dice rolls, or 128 coin flips when generating a new seed, and affected users are told to migrate to a fresh seed. This exploit directly contradicts the core promise of hardware wallets—that private keys remain safe even when the device is offline—by allowing attackers to guess keys generated with insufficient randomness. The incident highlights that a hardware wallet's security is only as strong as its random number generation, and it may push vendors and users to demand verifiable entropy sources. The flaw reduced effective entropy from 128 bits to roughly 40 bits on some devices and dates back to 2021, according to Coinkite. The update also replaces the Yasmarang backup pseudo-random number generator with SHA-256 Hash_DRBG, adds hardware RNG failure checks, verifies PSBTs immediately before signing, and tightens USB and Delta Mode handling.

title_zh: MANTRA因Cosmos EVM模块事件暂停全网
title_en: MANTRA halts network over Cosmos EVM module incident
summary_zh: 2026年8月21日，MANTRA Chain在发现攻击者利用与其Cosmos EVM模块相关的上游依赖漏洞后，暂停了所有交易、转账和质押。修复版本v8.4.0正在DuKong测试网上测试，之后才能进行协调的主网重启。 此次事件对MANTRA用户和整个Cosmos生态系统影响重大，因为全网暂停使所有链上活动停止，并引发了对第三方依赖安全性的质疑。这一事件可能影响市场对基于Cosmos的EVM链及上游开源组件安全的信任。 MANTRA团队表示，暂停本身并未影响用户资金，但攻击者活动的完整资产影响尚未确认，资金流向正在追踪中。验证者被要求在官方宣布协调重启前保持主网节点离线，DuKong测试网的测试是补丁版本上线的门槛。
summary_en: On August 21, 2026, MANTRA Chain halted all transactions, transfers, and staking after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in an upstream dependency linked to its Cosmos EVM module. The patched release v8.4.0 is being tested on the DuKong testnet before a coordinated mainnet restart can occur. This is a high-impact security event for MANTRA users and the broader Cosmos ecosystem, as the network-wide freeze silences all onchain activity and raises questions about the security of third-party dependencies. The incident could affect trust in Cosmos-based EVM chains and in the safety of upstream open-source components. The MANTRA team says the halt itself did not affect user funds, but the full asset impact of the attacker's activity remains unconfirmed and fund movements are being traced. Validators are instructed to keep mainnet nodes offline until a coordinated restart is announced, with DuKong testnet testing serving as the gate for the patched release.

title_zh: Coinbase CEO：CLARITY法案预计9月15日获得60多张参议院票
title_en: Coinbase CEO: CLARITY Act Set to Secure 60+ Senate Votes on Sept. 15
summary_zh: Coinbase首席执行官公开表示，CLARITY法案预计将在9月15日获得超过60张参议院票，表明这项加密市场结构法案获得了强有力的两党支持。这一预测凸显了该立法不断增长的势头。 这一进展意义重大，因为这意味着《数字资产市场清晰度法案》可能跨过在参议院克服冗长辩论所需的60票门槛。若该法案颁布，将界定SEC和CFTC对数字资产的监管管辖权，从根本上重塑美国加密市场结构，并降低交易所和项目面临的监管不确定性。 CLARITY法案，正式名称为《2025年数字资产市场清晰度法案》，是由参议院银行委员会主席蒂姆·斯科特和参议员辛西娅·卢米斯共同提出的两党法案。其核心目标是厘清SEC和CFTC在监管数字资产方面的各自角色，并建立更清晰的市场结构框架。
summary_en: Coinbase's CEO publicly stated that the CLARITY Act is expected to secure more than 60 Senate votes on September 15, signaling strong bipartisan support for the crypto market structure bill. The projection underscores growing momentum for the legislation. This development is significant because it suggests the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act could clear the 60-vote threshold needed to overcome a Senate filibuster. If enacted, it would define SEC and CFTC jurisdiction over digital assets, materially reshaping US crypto market structure and reducing regulatory uncertainty for exchanges and projects. The CLARITY Act, formally known as the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025, is a bipartisan bill introduced by Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott and Senator Cynthia Lummis. Its central aim is to clarify the respective roles of the SEC and the CFTC in overseeing digital assets and to establish a clearer market structure framework.

title_zh: Solana主网激活350毫秒时隙，创世以来首次缩减
title_en: Solana Activates 350ms Slots on Mainnet, First Cut Since Genesis
summary_zh: Solana将主网时隙时间从400毫秒缩短至350毫秒，这是自网络创世以来的首次缩减。这一变化开启了逐epoch向200毫秒目标迈进的进程，下一里程碑为300毫秒。 更短的时隙降低了网络延迟，加快了交易确认速度，改善了Solana用户和应用的体验。这增强了Solana作为高性能区块链的竞争力，也表明协议层面的优化仍在持续推进。 此次缩减由SIMD-0525提案推动，该提案已于5月14日获批并合并，截至发稿时平均时隙时间已降至360毫秒。后续向200毫秒目标迈进的各次50毫秒缩减计划在Anza开发的验证器客户端Agave v4.2中激活主网，但时间表仍为暂定。
summary_en: Solana reduced its mainnet slot time from 400ms to 350ms, marking the first such reduction since the network's inception. The change begins an epoch-by-epoch path toward a 200ms target, with 300ms as the next milestone. Shorter slots reduce network latency and speed up transaction confirmation, improving the experience for users and applications built on Solana. It strengthens Solana's competitive position as a high-performance blockchain and signals continued protocol-level optimization. The reduction was enabled by SIMD-0525, which was approved and merged on May 14, and average slot times already stood at 360ms at press time. The remaining 50ms reductions toward 200ms are targeted for mainnet activation in Agave v4.2, the validator client developed by Anza, though the schedule is tentative.

title_zh: Maya Protocol 遭攻击约1100万美元缺口未解，攻击者仍持20.83 BTC
title_en: Maya Protocol Exploit Leaves $11M Pool Damage Unresolved; Attacker Still Holds 20.83 BTC
summary_zh: 8月18日，Maya Protocol 遭到攻击，攻击者串联六个会计漏洞，盗走约4887万枚CACAO，并提取约165万至170万美元的资产。截至8月21日，疑似攻击者的比特币地址仍持有20.8273 BTC且无任何转出交易，Maya也未公布针对约1090万美元更大范围池损失的恢复计划。 此次攻击凸显了跨链流动性协议中持续存在的安全风险——单笔精心构造的交易就能引发连锁性的池损失。由于约1100万美元的影响仍未解决，且CACAO价格已下跌88.7%，用户对Maya Protocol及类似基于THORChain的网络的信心可能受到动摇。 SigIntZero的技术重建将攻击归因于一笔23条消息交易中串联的六个会计与状态处理缺陷——错误的重置状态触发了虚假的“转账缺失”信号，向一个薄弱的ARB.LINK池注入了约4945万枚CACAO。CryptoSlate分析认为，约640万美元的池损失来自CACAO重定价（从约0.115美元跌至0.013美元，跌幅88.7%），约290万美元来自套利。
summary_en: On Aug. 18, Maya Protocol suffered an exploit in which an attacker chained six accounting flaws to drain roughly 48.87 million CACAO and extract about $1.65–$1.7 million in assets. As of Aug. 21, the suspected attacker's Bitcoin address still holds 20.8273 BTC with no outgoing transactions, and Maya has not published a recovery plan for the wider ~$10.9 million pool impact. This exploit underscores persistent security risks in cross-chain liquidity protocols, where a single crafted transaction can trigger cascading pool losses. With ~$11 million in impact still unresolved and CACAO's price down 88.7%, user confidence in Maya Protocol and similar THORChain-based networks may be shaken. SigIntZero's technical reconstruction attributes the exploit to six accounting and state-handling flaws chained inside one 23-message transaction, which produced a false missing-transfer signal and credited ~49.45 million CACAO to a thin ARB.LINK pool. CryptoSlate analysis attributes ~$6.4 million of pool impact to CACAO repricing (from ~$0.115 to $0.013, an 88.7% decline) and ~$2.9 million to arbitrage.

title_zh: 美国公民因在边境删除手机数据面临重罪指控
title_en: U.S. Citizen Faces Felony Charges for Deleting Phone Data at Border
summary_zh: 美国公民 Samuel Tunick 因在边境搜查期间删除手机数据而面临重罪指控。此案凸显了旅客在试图保护美国入境口岸数字信息时所面临的法律风险。 这一指控可能为美国边境的数字隐私和公民自由树立一个令人不安的先例。政府声称有权对电子设备进行广泛检查。如果起诉成功，可能会阻止旅客行使对自己个人数据的控制权，并加剧对政府过度干预的担忧。 现有报道仅确认被起诉人为 Samuel Tunick，但未披露具体重罪罪名或法律依据。此案已成为关于边境搜查权力范围和数据隐私权的持续争论中的焦点。
summary_en: A U.S. citizen, Samuel Tunick, has been charged with felonies after deleting data on his phone during a border search. The case highlights the legal risks travelers face when they attempt to protect digital information at U.S. ports of entry. The charges could set a chilling precedent for digital privacy and civil liberties at U.S. borders, where the government asserts sweeping powers to inspect electronic devices. If the prosecution succeeds, it may deter travelers from exercising control over their personal data and escalate concerns about government overreach. The available reporting identifies Samuel Tunick as the person charged but does not disclose the specific felony counts or the legal theory behind them. The case has become a flashpoint in the ongoing debate over the scope of border-search powers and the right to data privacy.

title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5
title_en: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5
summary_zh: Anthropic宣布发布新版本AI模型Claude Sonnet 5。这一重大版本升级标志着模型能力的大幅提升。 Claude是领先的AI助手之一，因此此次重大发布可能对AI生态系统及依赖Anthropic模型的企业产生重大影响。同时，这也加剧了与其他AI实验室的竞争，可能加速该领域的创新。 公告确认了Claude Sonnet 5的存在和发布，但所提供内容中未提及具体技术规格、定价和可用性细节。Sonnet系列通常被定位为Anthropic的中端模型，在性能与效率之间取得平衡。
summary_en: Anthropic has announced the release of Claude Sonnet 5, a new version of its AI model. This major version increment signals substantial upgrades in the model's capabilities. Claude is one of the leading AI assistants, so a major release could significantly impact the AI ecosystem and businesses relying on Anthropic's models. It also intensifies competition with other AI labs, potentially accelerating innovation in the field. The announcement confirms the existence and release of Claude Sonnet 5, but specific technical specifications, pricing, and availability details were not available in the provided content. The Sonnet tier is typically positioned as Anthropic's mid-range model, balancing performance and efficiency.

title_zh: 主要P2P加密平台NoOnes因制裁关停
title_en: Major P2P Platform NoOnes Shuts Down After Sanctions Disrupt Operations
summary_zh: 拥有超过250万用户的点对点（P2P）加密货币平台NoOnes，在政府制裁及由此产生的监管限制导致运营难以为继后，正在逐步停止运营。 此次关停表明，政府制裁可能迫使重要的加密货币平台退出市场，直接影响用户的交易能力。这也凸显了依赖传统金融服务的加密交易所面临的监管和地缘政治风险。 NoOnes在2026年初用户数突破250万，并已为用户服务了三年。在制裁以及金融和加密服务提供商的限制导致运营无法继续后，平台为用户开放了紧急退出窗口以提取资金。
summary_en: NoOnes, a peer-to-peer crypto platform with over 2.5 million users, is winding down operations after government sanctions and resulting regulatory restrictions made continued operations unsustainable. This shutdown demonstrates how government sanctions can force significant crypto platforms out of business, directly affecting users' ability to trade. It underscores the regulatory and geopolitical risks facing crypto exchanges that depend on traditional financial services. NoOnes surpassed 2.5 million users earlier in 2026 and had served customers for three years. An emergency exit window was opened for users to withdraw funds after sanctions and restrictions from financial and crypto-service providers made operations impossible.

title_zh: Anthropic 提出用反事实实验评估 LLM 行为解释
title_en: Anthropic Proposes Counterfactual Experiments to Evaluate LLM Explanations
summary_zh: 该 Alignment Science 博客提出用反事实实验来评估大语言模型行为的解释，而不是依赖直觉或表面合理性。相关论文由 Adam Karvonen 等人撰写。 这很重要，因为 AI 可解释性和对齐领域缺乏判断模型行为解释是否正确严谨的标准。反事实测试提供了一种更科学的验证方式，有助于提升已部署 LLM 的可信度与安全性。 该方法将反事实实验应用于'真实场景'，即在真实模型行为上检验解释，而非合成或受控案例。论文在 arXiv 上的编号为 2608.16747，第一作者为 Adam Karvonen。
summary_en: The Alignment Science blog introduces a method for evaluating explanations of large language model behavior using counterfactual experiments, rather than relying on intuition or surface-level plausibility. The paper, titled 'Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments,' is authored by Adam Karvonen and colleagues. This matters because the AI interpretability and alignment fields lack rigorous standards for judging whether an explanation of model behavior is actually correct. Counterfactual testing offers a more scientific way to validate explanations, which could improve trust and safety in deployed LLMs. The approach applies counterfactual experiments 'in the wild,' meaning it tests explanations on real model behaviors rather than synthetic or controlled cases. The paper appears on arXiv under identifier 2608.16747, with Adam Karvonen as the first author.

title_zh: 币安在48小时内挫败攻击，挽回120万美元
title_en: Binance Thwarts Attack, Saves $1.2 Million in 48 Hours
summary_zh: 币安在48小时内侦测并化解了一次攻击，避免了约120万美元的潜在损失。据报此次事件中没有任何客户资金损失。 这一事件凸显了加密货币交易所面临的安全威胁形势，以及强健安全监控的重要性。成功阻止此类攻击有助于维持用户信任和交易所稳定。 币安的安全系统在资金受损之前就侦测并阻止了这次攻击，120万美元的数字代表被避免的潜在损失。据公告称，整个响应过程发生在48小时内。
summary_en: Binance detected and neutralized an attack within 48 hours, preventing approximately $1.2 million in potential losses. No customer funds were reported lost in the incident. This incident highlights the ongoing threat landscape for cryptocurrency exchanges and the importance of robust security monitoring. Successfully preventing such attacks helps maintain user trust and exchange stability. Binance's security systems detected and halted the attack before any funds were compromised, with the $1.2 million figure representing the potential loss averted. The response occurred within a 48-hour window, according to the announcement.

title_zh: 华尔街面临永续合约的紧迫生存危机
title_en: Wall Street Faces Urgent Perpetual Futures Existential Crisis
summary_zh: CNBC报道称，全天候永续合约交易的兴起使华尔街对加密衍生品的适应变得“紧迫”，并将永续合约形容为“24/7交易的强化版证券”。文章表明，传统交易模式必须适应全天候数字资产市场这一认识正在机构中增强。 永续合约是交易最活跃的加密衍生品，因此华尔街立场的任何结构性转变都可能影响数字资产的流动性、价格发现和波动性。这种紧迫感反映出传统交易所面临的竞争压力，以及加密原生市场基础设施日益增长的主流相关性。 永续合约没有到期日，依靠资金费率机制使合约价格锚定现货市场，允许交易者无限期持有杠杆头寸。CNBC的标题强调，这类产品如今对传统交易时间、清算和风险框架构成结构性挑战。
summary_en: CNBC reports that the rise of 24/7 perpetual futures trading has made Wall Street's adjustment to crypto derivatives 'urgent,' framing perpetuals as a '24/7 security on steroids.' The article signals growing institutional recognition that traditional trading models must adapt to round-the-clock digital asset markets. Perpetual futures are the most actively traded crypto derivatives, so any structural shift in Wall Street's stance can influence liquidity, price discovery, and volatility across digital assets. The urgency reflects competitive pressure on traditional exchanges and the growing mainstream relevance of crypto-native market infrastructure. Perpetual futures have no expiration date and rely on a funding rate mechanism to keep contract prices anchored to spot markets, enabling leveraged positions that can be held indefinitely. The CNBC headline emphasizes that this product class now represents a structural challenge to conventional market hours, clearing, and risk frameworks.

title_zh: 比特币逼近8万美元，空头爆仓40亿美元
title_en: Bitcoin Nears $80K, Erases $4B in Short Bets
summary_zh: 比特币在三天涨势中升至三个月高点78,449美元，抹去超过40亿美元的空头头寸。美国财政部回购公告和超过10亿美元的现货比特币ETF流入推动了这波行情，CryptoQuant的牛市评分指数也重新回到60的看涨区域。 这轮涨势表明宏观政策变化与机构需求相结合，可能引发加密货币衍生品市场的剧烈重新定价。牛市评分在5月高点时未能突破后重回看涨区域，表明市场基本面有所改善，不过行情的可持续性现在依赖于持续的现货买盘而非空头回补。 CryptoQuant的牛市评分指数升至60，为2025年10月以来首次进入看涨区域，十个指标中有六个转为正面，包括需求增长、稳定币流动性和交易者实现价格。分析师观点存在分歧：Nansen的Nicolai Søndergaard指出ETF流入帮助收复关键均线，而Alphractal首席执行官Joao Wedson称这不过是'救济性反弹'，基本面并未改变。
summary_en: Bitcoin jumped to a three-month high of $78,449, erasing more than $4 billion in short positions over a three-day rally. The move was fueled by Treasury buyback announcements and over $1 billion in spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, with CryptoQuant's Bull Score Index returning to bullish territory at 60. The rally shows how macro policy shifts and institutional demand can combine to trigger sharp derivatives repricing in crypto. The Bull Score's return to bullish after failing at May's highs signals stronger underlying market conditions, though the sustainability of the move now depends on sustained spot buying rather than short covering. CryptoQuant's Bull Score Index climbed to 60, its first bullish reading since October 2025, with six of its ten components turning positive, including demand growth, stablecoin liquidity, and trader realized price. Analysts are divided: Nansen's Nicolai Søndergaard noted ETF inflows helped reclaim key moving averages, while Alphractal CEO Joao Wedson called the move 'a relief rally' and said nothing has fundamentally changed.

title_zh: Coinbase推出AI代理交易平台，COIN股价上涨3%
title_en: Coinbase Launches AI Agent Platform for Crypto Payments, COIN Rises 3%
summary_zh: Coinbase推出了一个允许AI代理自主买卖和支付加密货币的平台，消息公布后COIN股价上涨超过3%。 这标志着向‘代理金融’（agentic finance）迈出了切实一步，自主AI系统将加密货币作为其金融后端。同时，这也让Coinbase占据了AI与加密的交汇点，可能从机器对机器支付中开辟新的收入来源。 据Decrypt报道，Coinbase的新工具是一个MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，允许AI代理持有钱包并发送稳定币支付，它建立在Coinbase用于机器对机器转账的x402协议之上。
summary_en: Coinbase introduced a payments platform that lets AI agents autonomously buy, sell, and pay using cryptocurrency, and COIN stock gained over 3% on the news. This marks a concrete step toward 'agentic finance,' where autonomous AI systems use crypto as their financial backend. It also positions Coinbase at the intersection of AI and crypto, potentially opening new revenue streams from machine-to-machine payments. According to Decrypt, Coinbase's new tool is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that allows AI agents to hold wallets and send stablecoin payments, and it builds on Coinbase's x402 protocol for machine-to-machine transfers.

title_zh: The Sandbox在遭攻击后暂停Base与BNB Chain桥接
title_en: Sandbox Halts Base and BNB Chain Bridging After Exploit
summary_zh: Web3游戏网络The Sandbox在发现漏洞后，暂停了与Base和BNB Chain的桥接。韩国交易所Upbit和Bithumb冻结了SAND的转账，其中Upbit还暂停了以太坊链上的充提及提现，而The Sandbox表示以太坊链并未受影响。 桥接漏洞可能直接危及用户资金，是加密领域价值最高的攻击目标之一，因此知名游戏网络暂停桥接会在整个生态中引发安全担忧。韩国交易所的冻结也显示，国家层面的用户保护法规可能中断受影响代币的交易。 The Sandbox表示，漏洞影响了与Base和BNB Chain的桥接，而以太坊据称未受影响。Upbit的行动依据韩国用户保护法，该法允许交易所在黑客攻击已发生或明显可能发生时阻止转账；目前尚未公布具体损失金额。
summary_en: The Sandbox, a Web3 gaming network, stopped bridging to Base and BNB Chain after discovering an exploit. South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb froze SAND transfers, with Upbit also halting deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum, which the studio says was not affected. Bridge exploits can directly jeopardize user funds and are among the highest-value targets in crypto, so any halt in a prominent gaming network raises security concerns across the ecosystem. The exchange freeze in South Korea also shows how national user-protection rules can interrupt trading in affected tokens. The Sandbox said the exploit affected bridging to Base and BNB Chain, while Ethereum was reportedly not impacted. Upbit's action followed South Korea's user-protection law, under which exchanges may block transfers when a hack has occurred or is clearly expected to occur; no loss figure has been published.

title_zh: SEC提议加密项目融资7500万美元并设安全港终止证券合约
title_en: SEC proposes $75M crypto fundraising path with safe harbor to end securities contract
summary_zh: 美国SEC提出了《Regulation Crypto Assets》加密资产条例，创建了加密项目专用融资豁免路径，允许项目在12个月内最高募集7500万美元，并提供有条件的Rule 400安全港，使发行人在完成承诺后可终止代币的证券合约。公众意见将于10月20日截止，在SEC通过最终规则前任何项目都不能使用该豁免。 这是一项具有里程碑意义的监管举措，为加密项目提供了合规的融资入口，以及退出证券状态的出口，可能重塑美国代币发行、上市和交易的方式。如果最终通过，将降低发行人和交易所的法律不确定性，并明确证券销售与功能性代币生态之间的分界线。 该提案包含三条融资通道：初创企业豁免在四年内最高500万美元，第一层（Tier 1）豁免在12个月内最高2000万美元，以及最高7500万美元的更大路径，并针对各层级设置了披露和散户购买限制。Rule 400安全港适用于任何合格的发行人，即使其通过Regulation D或其他豁免融资，也需提交公开文件并附书面说明。
summary_en: The SEC has proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, creating crypto-specific fundraising exemptions that allow projects to raise up to $75 million over 12 months, along with a conditional safe harbor (Rule 400) that lets issuers end the token's securities contract after fulfilling their promises. Comments are due October 20, and no project can use the exemptions until the SEC adopts a final rule. This is a landmark regulatory effort to give crypto projects a compliant on-ramp for capital formation and an off-ramp from securities status, potentially reshaping how tokens are issued, listed, and traded in the US. If finalized, it would reduce legal uncertainty for issuers and exchanges and clarify the dividing line between a security sale and a functional token ecosystem. The proposal includes three fundraising lanes: a startup exemption up to $5 million over a four-year period, a Tier 1 exemption up to $20 million in 12 months, and a larger path up to $75 million, with disclosures and retail limits scaled to each tier. The Rule 400 safe harbor is available to any qualifying issuer, even if it raised capital through Regulation D or other exemptions, and requires a public filing and written explanation.

title_zh: CFTC为美国市场扫清比特币永续期货障碍
title_en: CFTC Clears Bitcoin Perpetual Futures for US Markets
summary_zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）已为比特币永续合约在美国市场的交易扫清障碍，成为加密货币衍生品监管的一个重要里程碑。这为过去美国交易者难以接触的这一热门衍生品打开了大门。 该决定实质性扩大了比特币永续合约在美国这一全球最大衍生品市场之一的市场准入。它可能为加密货币衍生品带来更多机构流动性，并影响加密资产在受监管场所的交易和对冲方式。 永续合约与传统期货不同，没有到期日，可以无限期持有并以现金结算。CFTC的批准意味着受美国监管的交易平台现在可以提供这类合约，但公告未详细说明具体机制及哪些平台有资格。
summary_en: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has cleared the way for Bitcoin perpetual futures trading in U.S. markets, marking a significant regulatory milestone for crypto derivatives. This opens the door for a popular derivative product that had limited availability to U.S. traders. This decision materially expands market access for Bitcoin perpetual futures in the U.S., one of the world's largest derivatives markets. It could channel more institutional liquidity into crypto derivatives and influence how crypto assets are traded and hedged in regulated venues. Perpetual futures differ from traditional futures in having no expiry date, so positions can be held indefinitely and are settled in cash. The CFTC's clearance implies U.S.-regulated venues can now offer these contracts, though the exact mechanics and which platforms are eligible were not detailed in the announcement.

title_zh: 微软修复Entra ID中“满分10分”的远程代码执行漏洞
title_en: Microsoft Patches 'Perfect 10' Remote Code Execution Flaw in Entra ID
summary_zh: 微软披露并修复了Microsoft Entra ID中的一个严重漏洞CVE-2026-69836，其CVSS评分为10.0，属于远程代码执行漏洞。该漏洞无需任何权限或用户交互即可利用，根源是对不可信数据的反序列化处理不安全；微软确认该漏洞未被野外利用。 Entra ID是Microsoft 365、Azure及众多第三方应用背后的核心云身份与访问管理服务，因此该平台中出现无需权限的远程代码执行漏洞，即使已被修复也极其危险。此次披露也显示出AI在发现人工审查可能遗漏的漏洞方面发挥越来越重要的作用。 该漏洞源于对不可信数据的反序列化处理，攻击者可在低攻击复杂度下通过网络在未授权的情况下执行代码。CVE-2026-69836于2026年8月20日发布，微软随后将其利用状态从“是”改为“否”，仅称这是信息性修订。客户无需采取任何行动。
summary_en: Microsoft disclosed and patched CVE-2026-69836, a critical CVSS 10.0 remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID. The flaw requires no privileges or user interaction and is caused by insecure deserialization of untrusted data; Microsoft confirmed it was not exploited in the wild. Entra ID is the core cloud identity and access management service behind Microsoft 365, Azure, and thousands of third-party applications, so a privilege-free RCE in that platform is exceptionally dangerous even if already patched. The disclosure also shows the growing role of AI in discovering vulnerabilities that human reviewers may miss. The vulnerability stems from deserialization of untrusted data, allowing an unauthorized attacker to execute code over the network with low attack complexity. CVE-2026-69836 was published on August 20, 2026, and Microsoft later revised its exploitation status from 'Yes' to 'No,' calling the change informational only. No customer action is required.

title_zh: Zcash创八年新高逼近850美元，Grayscale推ETF助推
title_en: Zcash Surges to Eight-Year High Near $850 on Grayscale ETF Push
summary_zh: 据CoinGlass数据，Zcash价格已创下约850美元的八年新高，24小时期货交易量接近100亿美元，未平仓合约达17.6亿美元。此次上涨恰逢Grayscale推进Zcash ETF的申报。 此次飙升表明市场对隐私加密货币的兴趣上升，并可能为美国首只隐私币ETF铺平道路。高期货交易量显示当前涨势主要由衍生品而非现货交易驱动，这同时也带来了波动性风险。 据CoinGlass数据，衍生品占据大部分交投活动，24小时期货交易量接近100亿美元，未平仓合约达17.6亿美元。Grayscale的ETF申报将是首个面向隐私型数字资产的产品，而Zcash上一次接近该价位还需追溯至2018年的早期交易时期。
summary_en: Zcash's price reached an eight-year high near $850, with 24-hour futures volume hitting nearly $10 billion and open interest at $1.76 billion, according to CoinGlass. The surge came as Grayscale pushed forward with a Zcash ETF filing. This surge signals growing mainstream interest in privacy-focused cryptocurrencies and could pave the way for the first privacy-coin ETF in the US. The high futures volume shows derivatives, not spot trading, are driving the rally, which also carries volatility risks. Derivatives accounted for the bulk of activity, with nearly $10 billion in 24-hour futures volume and $1.76 billion in open interest, per CoinGlass. Grayscale's ETF filing would be the first for a privacy-focused digital asset, and Zcash's previous price around this level dates back to its early trading days in 2018.

title_zh: BitMart 宣布关闭数周后，考虑部分重启及债权人偿付
title_en: BitMart weighs partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after shutdown announcement
summary_zh: 据 CoinDesk 报道，BitMart 在宣布关闭数周后，正考虑部分重启并向债权人进行偿付。 这很关键，因为它可能决定 BitMart 用户能否收回资金，以及该交易所是否仍具备存续能力。在行业整合与破产频发的背景下，这也会影响用户对中心化加密货币交易所的信心。 报道称，这家交易所在宣布关闭数周后，正在权衡部分重启以及债权人偿付等选项。具体条款、金额和时间表尚未公布。
summary_en: BitMart is reportedly considering a partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after it announced it would shut down, according to CoinDesk. This matters because it could determine whether BitMart's users recover funds and whether the exchange retains any viability. It also affects confidence in centralized crypto exchanges during a period of consolidation and insolvencies. The report says the exchange is weighing options for a partial restart alongside creditor payouts, weeks after the shutdown announcement. Specific terms, amounts, and timelines have not been disclosed.

title_zh: Coinbase在应用中为Base和Solana推出即时链上代币交易
title_en: Coinbase Adds Instant Onchain Token Trading for Base and Solana in App
summary_zh: Coinbase已在其移动应用中为Base Layer 2网络和Solana上的代币引入了即时链上交易功能，用户无需离开应用即可直接交易这些资产。该功能拓宽了Coinbase庞大用户群接触链上资产的渠道。 此举使Coinbase成为中心化交易所服务与链上生态系统之间的桥梁，让主流用户能够直接接触Base和Solana等快速发展的网络。这也反映出中心化平台整合去中心化交易功能的行业趋势。 该公告未透露具体费用、完整支持代币列表或上线范围。Base是Coinbase构建的以太坊Layer 2网络，而Solana是独立的高吞吐量区块链，两个生态都拥有众多代币，包括模因币和DeFi资产。
summary_en: Coinbase has introduced instant onchain token trading for tokens on its Base Layer 2 network and on Solana directly within its mobile app, allowing users to trade these assets without leaving the app. The feature broadens access to onchain assets for Coinbase's large user base. This expansion positions Coinbase as a bridge between centralized exchange services and onchain ecosystems, giving mainstream users direct access to fast-growing networks like Base and Solana. It signals a broader industry trend of centralized platforms integrating decentralized trading features. The announcement does not disclose specific fees, the full list of supported tokens, or the rollout scope. Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 network built by Coinbase, while Solana is a separate high-throughput blockchain, and both ecosystems host numerous tokens, including meme coins and DeFi assets.

title_zh: 汇丰与渣打完成SWIFT区块链账本首笔银行间交易
title_en: HSBC and Standard Chartered Complete First Interbank Transaction on SWIFT Ledger
summary_zh: 渣打银行与汇丰银行在SWIFT基于区块链的账本上完成了首笔银行间交易。这标志着在SWIFT计划将基于DLT的账本嵌入核心基础设施之后，机构区块链采用迎来一个里程碑。 此事意义重大，因为两家全球系统重要性银行在现有SWIFT框架内通过区块链账本完成交易，将传统金融与DLT连接起来。它可能加速机构采用代币化跨境支付，并巩固SWIFT作为可信中立基础设施的地位。 SWIFT于2025年9月宣布将基于区块链的共享账本嵌入其核心系统。来自六大洲的17家银行正准备在该账本上试点代币化跨境支付的实时交易，而渣打与汇丰的这笔交易是该账本上的首笔银行间交易。
summary_en: Standard Chartered and HSBC completed the first interbank transaction on SWIFT's blockchain-based ledger. This marks a milestone in institutional blockchain adoption following SWIFT's plan to embed a DLT-based ledger into its core infrastructure. This is significant because two global systemically important banks are transacting on a blockchain ledger within the existing SWIFT framework, bridging traditional finance and DLT. It could accelerate institutional adoption of tokenised cross-border payments and validate SWIFT's role as a trusted neutral infrastructure. SWIFT announced in September 2025 that it would embed a blockchain-based shared ledger into its core. Seventeen banks from six continents are preparing to pilot live tokenised cross-border payment transactions on the ledger, and the Standard Chartered–HSBC transaction is the first interbank transaction on it.

title_zh: 比特币与以太坊ETF周流入26亿美元，创10月以来最强
title_en: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs See $2.6B Week, Highest Inflows Since October
summary_zh: 比特币和以太坊交易所交易基金（ETF）上周合计吸引26亿美元净流入，创下自10月以来最强单周表现。两类ETF合计交易量扩大至290亿美元，达到原先三倍多，同时比特币和以太坊价格出现上涨。 ETF资金流入和交易量激增，反映出机构及受监管渠道对数字资产的需求升温。这些产品的强劲流入有助于增强市场信心，并加深传统金融与加密货币市场之间的联动。 尽管本周行情反弹，但比特币和以太坊ETF年初至今仍为负回报。上述流入数据是比特币与以太坊产品的合计数字，而非单只基金的表现。
summary_en: Bitcoin and ether exchange-traded funds attracted a combined $2.6 billion in net inflows over the week, their strongest weekly showing since October. Combined trading volume for the two ETF categories more than tripled to $29 billion as bitcoin and ether prices rallied. The surge in ETF inflows and volume signals an uptick in institutional and regulated demand for digital assets. Strong flows into these products can reinforce market confidence and deepen the connection between traditional finance and cryptocurrency markets. Despite the weekly rally, both bitcoin and ether ETFs remain negative on a year-to-date basis. The inflow figure covers combined bitcoin and ether products rather than a single fund.

title_zh: 为什么你的本地大模型感觉比实际更笨
title_en: Why Your Local LLM Feels Dumber Than It Is
summary_zh: 这篇文章剖析了本地大模型为什么常常表现不如预期，重点讨论了量化、上下文窗口管理和推理配置。文中还包含了社区基准测试和实用的部署建议。 理解这些影响性能的因素，对任何部署本地大模型的人都很重要，因为不合理的配置会让能力很强的模型显得很弱。这也反映了本地推理正逐渐成熟，成为云端 API 之外的实用替代方案。 讨论中提到了 NVFP4 和 AWQ W4A16 等量化格式，并指出低质量量化可能导致工具调用失败。社区成员报告称，使用 Q8 量化并避免对 KV 缓存进行压缩有助于保持准确性，而 llama.cpp 的语法约束机制可以防止格式错误的工具调用。
summary_en: The article breaks down why local LLMs often underperform expectations, focusing on quantization, context window management, and inference configurations. It includes community benchmarks and practical deployment tips. Understanding these performance factors is crucial for anyone deploying local LLMs, as poor setup can make capable models appear weak. It highlights the growing maturity of local inference as a practical alternative to cloud APIs. The discussion covers quantization formats such as NVFP4 and AWQ W4A16, noting that low-quality quants can lead to tool-call failures. Community members report that using Q8 quantization and avoiding KV cache compression help preserve accuracy, while llama.cpp's grammar enforcement can prevent malformed tool calls.

title_zh: Munder Difflin：用AI克隆体组建“办公室”的多智能体编排工具
title_en: Munder Difflin: Run an Office of Your Own AI Coding Agent Clones
summary_zh: Munder Difflin 是一款免费开源本地桌面应用，将 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等现有终端编码代理封装成“蜂巢思维”，让一个管理者代理（Michael）协调一群克隆代理。该项目宣称支持确定性模拟、不消耗 token，并且上线一周内已吸引超过 2 万名用户。 该工具解决了多智能体 AI 编程中的一个痛点：在协调多个代理时不浪费 token。它展示了如何将已有的编码代理订阅重新用于确定性的、可复用的代理团队，可能改变开发者对代理编排和成本效率的思考方式。 该工具包装用户现有的 CLI 编码代理，并使用其每小时订阅限制，而非单独收费。它宣称具备确定性模拟（相同输入产生相同结果）、无 token 消耗，并支持“几乎所有”编码代理；官网列出了 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等九种以上代理。
summary_en: Munder Difflin is a free, open-source local desktop app that wraps existing terminal coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot into a 'hive mind,' letting a single manager agent (Michael) coordinate an office of cloned agents. The project claims deterministic simulations that consume no tokens and has reportedly attracted 20K+ users within a week of launch. This tool addresses a pain point in multi-agent AI coding: coordinating multiple agents without wastefully burning tokens. It shows how existing coding-agent subscriptions can be repurposed into deterministic, reusable agent teams, potentially changing how developers think about agent orchestration and cost efficiency. The harness wraps the user's existing CLI coding agents and uses their hourly subscription limits, rather than charging separately. It claims deterministic simulations (same inputs produce same outcomes), token-free operation, and support for 'almost all' coding-agent harnesses, with the site listing Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and nine more.
